description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Special Commodity Levy on Fresh Orange and Fresh Apples
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the imposition and amendment of a Special Commodity Levy under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It contains regulatory changes to tax rates on specific commodities, which falls under legal/regulatory matters (new regulations, statutory instruments, and compliance requirements). While it mentions Minister Mahinda Rajapaksa, it does so only in the context of exercising statutory powers to implement regulatory changes, without detailing his portfolio responsibilities or making personnel changes.
